Edge Network’s switches are designed to manage and control traffic flow under the harshest conditions with varying architectures and topologies for redundancy to insure your devices are accessible when you need them. Available with either Layer 2 or Layer 3 protocols, and optional POE in many different port counts, Edge Networks has the switch you need. Edge Network’s Ethernet Extenders will allow you to run full 10/100MBPS ethernet over COAX or UTP cable at distances up to 1 mile. Perfect for access to those hard to reach areas or converting over from analog video.
